items.t: Cracked fuel injector can leak gasoline (recall)
items.job: Engine software update, then replace high-pressure fuel rail and injectors
items.note: Free under recalls 22V-859, 24V-187, 25V-165 and 25V-467. Earlier repairs may need the newer remedy.

items.t: Coolant pump leak and low coolant
items.job: Flush cooling system and replace coolant pump
items.note: Ford bulletin labor time ran from 3.1 hours down to 2.4 hours. Often covered by the factory warranty on newer SUVs.

items.t: 12V battery can fail suddenly and cut power (recalls)
items.job: Reprogram body and powertrain modules; test and replace 12V battery if needed
items.note: Free under recall. Outside the recall, a new 12V battery costs about $150 to $300 installed.

items.t: Front ball joint can separate from the knuckle (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair front lower ball joints
items.note: Do-not-drive recall. Free at a Ford dealer; ask about towing.

items.t: Oil separator housing can crack and leak oil (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace oil separator and seals
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear drive unit low on oil can seize (recall)
items.job: Check rear drive unit oil level; refill or replace unit
items.note: Free under recall 21V-011.

items.t: Engine block heater can crack and short out (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater or install a threaded plug
items.note: Free under recall 25V-685. Do not plug the heater in until it is fixed.

items.t: Engine block heater can overheat when plugged in (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater element and inspect the cord
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera blank or stays on (recall)
items.job: Update rear camera and infotainment software
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump module can leak in the tank and stall (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel delivery module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake pads may not stop as well as designed (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pads
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Moonroof glass may not be bonded and could come off (recall)
items.job: Inspect moonroof glass and replace if needed
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front control arms or rear subframe bolts may be faulty (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and replace front lower control arms or secure rear subframe bolts
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump control module bracket can loosen and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank assembly
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Parking lights flicker with the headlights on (recall)
items.job: Replace LED driver module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS module can leak inside and lengthen pedal travel (recall)
items.job: Replace ABS module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace wiper motor
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tires may have a manufacturing defect (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace tires
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Check-engine light from a failed purge valve
items.job: Replace vapor management (purge) valve
items.note: CarComplaints owners reported about $400 total.

items.t: Cylinder head plugs can leak oil (recall)
items.job: Replace cylinder head as needed
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster can go dark (recalls)
items.job: Replace instrument cluster or update software
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR valve
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor may misread who is in the seat (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger occupant classification sensor
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Pistons may be made wrong and fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect pistons; replace engine long block if needed
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Body or suspension joints may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten joints; repair retainers
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: AWD chatter or shudder in slow tight turns
items.job: Replace rear drive unit vent hose and change rear drive unit fluid
items.note: Ford bulletin labor time is 0.8-0.9 hours. Parts shown are the updated vent hose (K2GZ-4022-M); add the cost of Motorcraft rear drive unit fluid. Often covered by warranty on newer SUVs.
